methodology: U-Net++ architecture featuring three main modifications over the original U-Net: re-designed skip pathways, dense skip connections, and deep supervision. The preprocessing includes applying four Gabor filters (at angles 90°, 45°, 0°, and -45°) to grey images to extract texture features before green channel segmentation.
key_findings: The redesigned skip pathways in U-Net++ aim to bridge the semantic gap between the encoder and decoder feature maps, making optimization easier by fusing semantically similar feature maps.
